title: Bug ?? Connected to power but NS not uploading
symptom: When the phone is connected to power but the battery is full, Nightscout does not upload data even though the upload setting is set to 'when charging' only.
cause: The phone is not charging because the battery is full, so the condition for uploading is not met.
fix: A small update was made to improve the connection status updating speed, and it was suggested that uploading while fully charged should work.
evidence_quote: Technically, the phone isn't charging (as the battery is full) but it is still connected to external power.
